House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". A quiet conversation about doubt. It echoes the seed story: Sam does not understand everything, but he believes in God. Marta speaks from experience, not from doctrine.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Det er søndag kveld. Sam sitter hos Marta. Han tenker mye.
sentences.english: It is Sunday evening. Sam sits at Marta's. He thinks a lot.

sentences.text: Hva tenker du på, Sam?
sentences.english: What are you thinking about, Sam?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Jeg tror på Gud, men jeg har mange spørsmål. Ofte har jeg tvil.
sentences.english: I believe in God, but I have many questions. Often I have doubt.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Det er ikke dårlig å ha tvil. Alle folk har tvil.
sentences.english: It is not bad to have doubt. All people have doubt.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Har du hatt tvil, Marta?
sentences.english: Have you had doubt, Marta?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ja, mange ganger. Da jeg var liten, var jeg ikke sikker.
sentences.english: Yes, many times. When I was small, I was not sure.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Hva gjorde du da?
sentences.english: What did you do then?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jeg leste i bibelen, og jeg ba. Jeg ventet på svar.
sentences.english: I read in the Bible, and I prayed. I waited for an answer.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Fikk du svar?
sentences.english: Did you get an answer?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ikke alltid. Men jeg var ikke redd. Jeg kjente Gud.
sentences.english: Not always. But I was not afraid. I knew God.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Er du sikker på det nå?
sentences.english: Are you sure of that now?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jeg er ikke sikker på mye. Men jeg er trygg. Jeg kjenner Gud, og han kjenner meg.
sentences.english: I am not sure of much. But I feel safe. I know God, and he knows me.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Kan du ha tvil og være trygg?
sentences.english: Can you have doubt and feel safe?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ja, det kan jeg. Jeg har hatt mange spørsmål. Gud har hjulpet meg hver dag.
sentences.english: Yes, I can. I have had many questions. God has helped me every day.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Sam sitter lenge og tenker. Så sier han: «Takk, Marta. Nå har jeg et svar.»
sentences.english: Sam sits and thinks for a long time. Then he says: "Thank you, Marta. Now I have an answer."

sentences.text: Hva er svaret?
sentences.english: What is the answer?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Jeg trenger ikke å være sikker på alt. Jeg trenger å kjenne Gud.
sentences.english: I do not need to be sure of everything. I need to know God.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Det er et godt svar. Vi ber for deg, Sam, hver dag.
sentences.english: That is a good answer. We pray for you, Sam, every day.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Sam er glad. Han har fortsatt spørsmål, men han er trygg.
sentences.english: Sam is happy. He still has questions, but he feels safe.

sentences.text: Hvilken film så vi på fredag?
sentences.english: Which film did we watch on Friday?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Filmen om fjell. Vi satt i sofaen, spiste taco og spilte etterpå.
sentences.english: The film about mountains. We sat on the sofa, ate tacos and played afterwards.
sentences.speaker: nico
